welcome.title: Welcome to LicenseMeter
welcome.body: Start here — connect Microsoft 365 (or upload a CSV) and LicenseMeter finds your license waste automatically.

waste.title: Your waste, right now
waste.body: This is what you're overpaying this month. Annualized waste projects it over 12 months.

trend.title: Spend and waste over time
trend.body: Watch this drop as you act on findings.

findings.title: Findings are concrete savings
findings.body: Each finding is one actionable saving: an inactive user, a duplicate license, an unused seat.

connectors.title: Cover your whole stack
connectors.body: Open Connectors to connect Adobe, Zoom, Atlassian, Salesforce and the rest of your stack.

metricInfo.title: Explainers everywhere
metricInfo.body: Unsure what a metric means? Every card has an explainer behind the i button.
